title: The garden
text: Outside, the garden is a rectangle of optimism and mud. You plant things in the order that seemed sensible in the shop and discover, in May, that the order was not sensible at all. A bench arrives, assembled by two people who have read the instructions together and agreed to ignore most of them. Rain comes in the afternoon and you both stand under the eaves, watching the beds drink. It is not a garden yet. It is a promise with a lot of soil on it, and you intend to keep it.
